notes.title: V1.7 Revision 2
notes.content:
CHANGELOG:

Goreblasters were slightly buffed
Final Boss was buffed a lot
Weather effects were added to MAP08 and MAP11
Liquids are animated
Hawk was buffed
Added an incredibly super secret ability
General graphical changes

Other stuff:

Save data. I hate to say it, but gzdoom sucks when it comes to save data. This latest update will cause problems if you have old save data, so don't feel bad using console commands to get back to where you were.

And an apology. Shit out that last update without a changelog. We've been busy with holidays so it's been hard to stay on top of it, so please forgive us for that blunder.

If you have any bugs to report, please report them in the community forums.
